audited_source_corrections.action: Assume positive cut length only; allow cut rank zero in the induction step.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source asserts both cut rank and cut length are positive after ruling out zero cut length, but atomic cut formulas have depth and hence cut rank zero.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: The Tamil keeps the lexicographic induction and says cut length is positive while cut rank may be zero.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retain the false positive-rank assumption and leave atomic cuts outside the proof.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The adjacent segment definition sets cut rank to formula depth; the frozen formula-depth definition assigns depth zero to atomic formulas.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the induction cover a nonempty set of atomic cuts at rank zero?
